overview: This Senate resolution supports naming May 2, 2025, National Space Day. It highlights the work of NASA, the military, private aerospace companies and research centers, pointing to achievements such as the Apollo 11 moon landing, the Space Shuttle, Mars rovers and the James Webb Space Telescope, and technologies like GPS that came out of space programs. It recognizes the whole aerospace community, its contributions to exploration and science, and its partnerships with the armed forces, and encourages science, technology, engineering and math (STEM) education. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on May 14, 2025.
for: Supporters say it celebrates American achievements in space and encourages young people to pursue science and engineering careers.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it does not change any law or spending.
